'''Nargans''' were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. They were not technologically advanced, and were [[Speciesism|xenophobic]] toward [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
